messages:
Maya Patel: SunriseHealth procurement just sent a combined security & DPA form. They want SOC2 evidence, encryption at rest/in-transit specifics, customer-key options, audit log exports, and whether we support field-level tokenization for PII. They want answers by Tue EOD or procurement will pause the PO.

Jordan Kim: Oof timeline. Who can take the reply? Keep it short and procurement-friendly.

Liam O'Neil: Ill own the reply and paste approved wording. Devon, can you provide short, procurement-safe bullets? Also confirm EU-region residency line.

Devon Chen: Draft bullets below  safe to paste.

Devon Chen: "Encryption at rest: Data stored in Redwood-managed services is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with envelope encryption. Hosted customers use provider KMS by default; Dedicated/Private deployments support customer-managed keys (CMKs) and HSM integrations. Key rotation is performed per our crypto policy; customers may schedule CMK rotations for Private deployments."

Devon Chen: "Encryption in transit: All service endpoints enforce TLS 1.3 with HSTS. Private deployments may be configured for mutual TLS."

Devon Chen: "Audit logs & export: Access, admin, and system audit events are retained 180 days by default for Hosted; Dedicated/Private can extend retention or stream logs to customer S3/Blob storage. We can provide redacted sample events under NDA and a log schema for procurement review."

Devon Chen: "Compliance scope: Redwood holds SOC2 Type II for our hosted platform and maintains ISO 27001 certification for core controls. For Private/on-prem customers, we provide evidence packages to assist customer audits."

Liam O'Neil: Nice. Ill paste these and add: 'We support EU-region data placement; please indicate preferred region on the form.' Also flagging that extended log retention is an enterprise add-on.

OnboardBot: Task created: "Reply to SunriseHealth security form" assigned to Liam O'Neil, due 2025-12-02.

Liam O'Neil: Sent draft to procurement & SunriseHealth at 1901234628. Included Devon bullets + line about EU-region and enterprise log retention. Marked as procurement-ready.

Maya Patel: Great 44d. Please paste SunriseHealth reply here. If they ask for more evidence escalate to AE.

Liam O'Neil: SunriseHealth replied at 1901234705 asking whether we can do field-level tokenization for phone numbers and SSNs. I asked for context (flows and retention). Looping in Devon to confirm product options.

Devon Chen: For tokenization: we support application-level tokenization patterns and token vaulting for Hosted customers. For strong PCI/PII tokenization, recommend Private deployment with customer HSM + tokenization proxy. Ill draft a short product note to paste.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. Keeping these replies concise reduces friction and lowers the chance of renewal slippage.
